title: Bronze is a raw copy, cleaning happens in Silver
script: Show the same bad row in Bronze and in Silver side by side. Ask: if we fixed it in Bronze and the fix was wrong, how would we get the original back?

title: Do not delete raw rows, filter them later
script: Walk through a cleaning rule that changes next week. Show that deleted rows cannot be reprocessed, while kept rows can.

title: Where dbt tests live
script: Open a schema.yml file and add a unique test to a column live, then run dbt test.
